notes: Faint typescript. Report's own number: STATION 40. Title read as 'DIVERSION - ELLWOOD DAIRIES' (the letter after ELL is nearly illegible); minutes of latitude read as 28 (faint). Description: wood-curbed seep in alluvium of creek bottom, discharge measured at inflow to settling box; altitude about 320 feet. Data type Irrigation because the page calls it a diversion; Springs would fit the description (seep). Dates: Aug. 16, 1948; Feb. 17, 1949; Mar. 16, Mar. 30, Apr. 26 (under 1949). No place, county or state printed.
